title: Health matched-pair persona experiment
purpose: Measure expression of controlled preferences and CUA response on six unchanged assigned Odysseys Health tasks.

arm_labels.positive: The focal/high-expression pole used for the controlled contrast.
arm_labels.negative: The opposite comparison pole. Negative is an experimental label, not a quality judgment.

pairing_controls: Keep the frozen upstream task and all ordinary rubrics identical across both arms.
Keep display name, non-target baseline dimensions, prompts, model identities, temperature, step limit, and replicate ID fixed within a pair.
Change exactly the selected official MatrAIx dimension between arms.
Use the planner's isolated per-replicate/task/axis/arm Chrome profiles and deterministic counterbalanced order.
Materialize and review both full-coverage openings before any two-cell browser smoke run; reuse that exact opening configuration.
Declare local Chrome/Playwright as the runtime; do not describe these results as OSWorld.
Use the identical verbatim task prefix in both arms; append only that arm's authored preference from the frozen protocol.
invalid_pair_conditions: Either arm omits, weakens, or contradicts any original task or R1-Rn requirement.
The arms differ in a controlled variable other than the target dimension.
A persona is run on a task outside its declared applicability map.
One pole is inferred only from silence or inherited task wording.
A fixed opening differs from the exact task plus its assigned authored preference.
design.axis_selection_note: Six synthetic preference personas in three controlled pairs. V3 uses the verbatim original task plus a protocol-authored preference. The LLM supplies clarification replies only. This tests CUA response to explicit preferences; initial persona expression is controlled by construction, not measured as spontaneous simulator fidelity. V1/v2 failed opening previews are retained.
design.pilot: One selected axis per task, two arms each: detail_depth on Pilates and local yoga; decision_style on YouTube yoga and Fresno fitness; evidence_verification on maternity hospitals and knee surgeons. Twelve pilot cells; the full applicability matrix remains 24 cells per replicate. This is a feasibility pilot, not three formal replicates.

scoring.evidence_unit: Cited simulated-user utterances; neither agent actions nor original task wording alone proves persona expression.

per_arm_scale.0: Absent, contradicted, or expressed by violating any hard task requirement.
per_arm_scale.1: Weak or ambiguous, including evidence inherited from the original task alone.
per_arm_scale.2: Clear task-specific expression beyond inherited wording, without contradiction or loss of requirements.

scoring.binary_adherence_rule: An arm is expressed if and only if its score is 2.
scoring.pair_separation_rule: A valid pair separates only when both opposite arms score 2, both preserve all original requirements, and the cited evidence shows meaningfully opposite preferences.
scoring.coverage_guardrail: Both arms must communicate 100% of the original R1-Rn requirements. Preserve all fields, counts, sites, titles, tabs, source checks, playback, and required concise comparisons.
reporting: Report original task success and communicated coverage separately.
Report each arm's 0/1/2 expression score, citations, contradictions, and pair validity/separation separately.
Report P1-P5 experience separately; do not relabel it as CUA alignment.
Keep environment/site failures and unavailable evidence visible; never rewrite frozen tasks or quietly adjust raw scores.
Retain task, protocol, profile, model, prompt, runtime, replicate, and order identities.

positive.behavioral_definition: Requests compact task-relevant optional detail beyond the mandatory fields without expanding a requested short answer into a long report.
generic_observables: Asks for a specific optional field or explanation beyond the original rubric.
Names the extra detail that would help interpret the required findings.
contradictions: Explicitly asks for mandatory fields only and rejects optional detail.
Uses extra detail as a reason to omit any required item or violate a concise-output requirement.

negative.behavioral_definition: Affirmatively asks for the mandatory fields and comparison only, omitting optional background while preserving all evidence and material qualifications.
generic_observables: Explicitly limits optional context to keep the output focused on all required fields.
Names an optional type of background they do not want.
contradictions: Requests substantial optional background or extra fields.
Drops a mandatory field, source, verification, count, tab, or material qualification to shorten the answer.
